name: How do I choose the right contractor to rebuild after interior water damage?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right contractor to rebuild after interior water damage?

acceptedAnswer.text: Look for a licensed, insured finish contractor who has hands-on experience in drywall finishing, carpentry, and interior painting, rather than a broad demolition crew. Review verified customer ratings, such as an A+ Better Business Bureau standing, and ask if the business owner will be on-site leading the project. You should also verify that the contractor understands how to blend joint compound textures with your existing walls and can coordinate trades for any hidden plumbing or electrical lines uncovered behind damaged drywall.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose an experienced interior finish contractor with strong credentials, verified reviews, hands-on job leadership, and skilled drywall, carpentry, and painting capabilities.
